JAH-ADVCG-000026.name: Photonic Memory Fabrics (Signature Edition)
JAH-ADVCG-000026.title: Photonic Memory Fabrics (Signature Edition)
JAH-ADVCG-000026.description: Memory woven from light: photonic memory fabrics. The photonic memory fabric weaves storage from light: optical memory cells that hold data as trapped photons, read without conversion. The design's promise is the bandwidth — the memory speaks to the processor in light, and the bus bottleneck dissolves.
JAH-ADVCG-000026.how_it_works: Resonant photonic structures trap and release photons as memory states.
requirements: Photonics literature, optical memory references, nanofabrication tools
citations: Photonics and optical memory (standard literature). Signature-original designs.

JAH-ADVCG-000027.name: The All-Optical Switch (Signature Edition)
JAH-ADVCG-000027.title: The All-Optical Switch (Signature Edition)
JAH-ADVCG-000027.description: Routing light with light: the all-optical switch. The all-optical switch routes light with light: no electronic middleman, just photons directing photons. The device's physics is the nonlinearity — the light that changes the medium for the light that follows.
JAH-ADVCG-000027.how_it_works: Nonlinear optical materials let control beams switch signal beams entirely in the optical domain.
requirements: Nonlinear optics references, photonic switch designs, test instrumentation

JAH-ADVCG-000028.name: The Photonic Pond Computer (Signature Edition)
JAH-ADVCG-000028.title: The Photonic Pond Computer (Signature Edition)
JAH-ADVCG-000028.description: The pond that computes: photonic reservoirs. The photonic reservoir computer is the pond that computes: a disordered photonic network that the input ripples through, and the readout learns the ripples. The paradigm's beauty is the training — only the readout learns; the reservoir just is.
JAH-ADVCG-000028.how_it_works: Disordered photonic networks project inputs into high-dimensional optical states for simple readout training.
requirements: Reservoir computing literature, photonic network designs, ML references

JAH-ADVCG-000029.name: The Coherent Photonic Mesh (Signature Edition)
JAH-ADVCG-000029.title: The Coherent Photonic Mesh (Signature Edition)
JAH-ADVCG-000029.description: The mesh that multiplies: coherent photonic networks. The coherent photonic mesh multiplies in light: the mesh of interferometers that performs matrix operations at the speed of the photons. The architecture's power is the parallelism — the whole matrix, in one flash.
JAH-ADVCG-000029.how_it_works: Meshes of Mach-Zehnder interferometers implement matrix-vector multiplication optically.
requirements: Photonic mesh literature, interferometer designs, linear algebra references

JAH-ADVCG-000030.name: Plasmonic Interconnect Bridges (Signature Edition)
JAH-ADVCG-000030.title: Plasmonic Interconnect Bridges (Signature Edition)
JAH-ADVCG-000030.description: Light on metal: plasmonic bridges. The plasmonic bridge carries light on metal: the surface plasmons that squeeze photons into nanoscale wires. The bridge's role is the translator — the plasmonic link between the photonic highway and the electronic street.
JAH-ADVCG-000030.how_it_works: Surface plasmon polaritons confine light below the diffraction limit for nanoscale interconnects.
requirements: Plasmonics literature, nanofabrication references, interconnect designs

JAH-ADVCG-000031.name: Photonic Analog Solvers (Signature Edition)
JAH-ADVCG-000031.title: Photonic Analog Solvers (Signature Edition)
JAH-ADVCG-000031.description: The light that solves equations: analog photonic solvers. The photonic analog solver solves equations in light: the differential equation mapped to the optical network, the answer read at the detectors. The solver's speed is the physics — the light computes as it propagates.
JAH-ADVCG-000031.how_it_works: Optical networks are configured so light propagation itself solves the target equations.
requirements: Analog computing literature, photonic solver designs, applied math references
citations: Analog optical computing (standard literature). Signature-original designs.

JAH-ADVCG-000032.t: The Optical Frequency Comb Engine (Signature Edition)
JAH-ADVCG-000032.name: The Optical Frequency Comb Engine (Signature Edition)
JAH-ADVCG-000032.title: The Optical Frequency Comb Engine (Signature Edition)
JAH-ADVCG-000032.description: A rainbow ruler: the comb engine. The optical frequency comb engine rules light: the comb's evenly spaced teeth are the ruler for the spectrum. The engine's applications are the precision — the clocks, the spectroscopy, the ranging.
JAH-ADVCG-000032.how_it_works: Microresonator combs generate precise multi-wavelength sources for measurement and computing.
requirements: Frequency comb literature, microresonator designs, metrology references

JAH-ADVCG-000033.name: Photonic In-Memory Compute (Signature Edition)
JAH-ADVCG-000033.title: Photonic In-Memory Compute (Signature Edition)
JAH-ADVCG-000033.description: Compute where the data lives: in-memory photonics. The photonic in-memory computer computes where the data lives: the memory array that multiplies as it stores. The architecture's victory is the vanquished bus — the data never travels, so the energy never wastes.
JAH-ADVCG-000033.how_it_works: Phase-change photonic memories perform multiply-accumulate within the storage array.
requirements: In-memory computing literature, phase-change photonics, architecture references

JAH-ADVCG-000034.name: The Hybrid Electronic-Photonic Stack (Signature Edition)
JAH-ADVCG-000034.title: The Hybrid Electronic-Photonic Stack (Signature Edition)
JAH-ADVCG-000034.description: The marriage: the hybrid stack. The hybrid stack marries the electronic and the photonic: the electrons for the logic, the photons for the movement. The stack's design is the interface — the modulators and detectors where the domains meet.
JAH-ADVCG-000034.how_it_works: 3D integration bonds photonic interconnect layers to electronic logic dies.
key_points: Electrons for logic; photons for movement.
requirements: Hybrid integration literature, 3D stacking references, interface designs

JAH-ADVCG-000035.name: The Photonic Apprentice's Handbook (Signature Edition)
JAH-ADVCG-000035.title: The Photonic Apprentice's Handbook (Signature Edition)
JAH-ADVCG-000035.description: The capstone: learning the light. The photonic apprentice's handbook is the capstone: the curriculum for the light — the foundations, the compounded, the advanced. The handbook's path is the ladder: the apprentice climbs from the ray to the quantum.
JAH-ADVCG-000035.how_it_works: The handbook orders photonic knowledge simple to compounded to most complex.
key_points: From the ray to the quantum.
requirements: Photonics textbooks, curriculum design references, laboratory manuals
